senses.def: Of or pertaining to the Jynx genus; pertaining to or characteristic of the wryneck.
A bird, the wryneck, once thought a bird of ill omen (Jynx torquilla).
ex: Its sharp and harsh cry, resembling a repetition of 'Jynx', 'Jynx', 'Jynx'.
These are the Philtres, Allurements, Jynges, Inveiglements [les philtres, iynges, et attraictz], Baits, and Enticements of Love.

senses.def: One of an order of spiritual intelligences in ancient “Chaldaic” philosophy.
